card.name: Contraindication section references
card.fires_on: Spaces or verbs right before a section cross-reference number, such as "( 4 )" in a contraindications list, and "is" just before "contraindicated".

modes.label: Space before section number
modes.description: The blank gap inside parentheses just before a section number like 4 or 7 after a listed contraindication.

modes.label: "is" before contraindicated
modes.description: The verb "is" after a drug or class named as not to be combined, right before the word contraindicated.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a contraindications list where a section number or the word contraindicated comes next.
